name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana (EBC/EWS) - Technical and Professional courses
provider: Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra (via MahaDBT)

rules.quote: The Total Annual Income of Family / Guardian should not be more than 8 Lakhs.
Candidate should be Domicile of Maharashtra State.
admitted for Professional and Technical course (Diploma / Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

rules.value: Deemed and private universities excluded; CAP admission required
rules.quote: Deemed University and Private university is not applicable.

rules.value: CAP admission; no other scholarship; max 2 children per family; 50% attendance; no gap of 2+ years
rules.quote: Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

rules.value: Female students get 100% tuition and exam fee; male 50%

amount.text: Tuition fee and exam fee: 50% for male, 100% for female students (income up to Rs 8 lakh), paid in two instalments
amount.quote: Through MahaDBT Portal, The Benefit of Scheme will be disbursed in two Installment in Aadhar Seeded Bank Account.

documents.name: Family income certificate
documents.quote: Previous Year Family Annual Income certificate.

deadline.text: Apply on MahaDBT; no date on scheme page
